WITH customer_consumption AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_consumption AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM customer_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest_customers AS (
    SELECT cc.Segment, cc.total_consumption
    FROM customer_consumption cc
    JOIN min_consumption mc ON cc.Segment = mc.Segment AND cc.total_consumption = mc.min_consumption
),

    SELECT Segment, SUM(total_consumption) / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest_customers
    GROUP BY Segment
)

WITH spending AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Amount * Price) AS total_spending
    FROM transactions_1k
    GROUP BY CustomerID
)
SELECT
    c.CustomerID,
    AVG(t.Price / t.Amount) AS avg_price_per_item,
    c.Currency
FROM customers c
JOIN transactions_1k t ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.CustomerID = (SELECT CustomerID FROM spending ORDER BY total_spending DESC LIMIT 1)
GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Currency
